events.body:
## Bug

`website/views/project.py` calls `sentry_sdk.capture_exception(e)` inside an `except requests.RequestException` handler (lines 1893 and 1903), but `sentry_sdk` is never imported in the module. When the outer request fails — the case this handler exists to report — `sentry_sdk.capture_exception` raises `NameError: name 'sentry_sdk' is not defined`, masking the original RequestException with a NameError (500).

## Repro

Make the outer `requests` call in that view fail (network error / handled RequestException) so the except handler runs → NameError.

## Suggested fix

    import sentry_sdk

If Sentry is not actually configured for blt-legacy, replace the capture calls with `logger.exception(...)` instead, so the handler logs rather than crashes.

Found by static analysis (ruff F821); no star-import masks the name. AI model used in analysis: Claude Opus 4.8 (Claude Code).
